question: If 6 men and 8 boys can do a piece of work in 10 days while 26 men and 48 boys can do the same work in 2 days, then the time taken by 20 men for doing the same piece of work will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Let the efficiency of men = m and boys = b.

6m + 8b = 10 days ---(1)

26m + 48b = 2 days ---(2)

**Concept Used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

From equation (1) and (2):

⇒ (6m + 8b) × 10 = (26m + 48b) × 2

⇒ 60m + 80b = 52m + 96b

⇒ 8m = 16b

⇒ {m over b} = {2 over 1} ---(3)

Substituting the values of m and b from equation (3):

Total Work = (6 × 2 + 8 × 1) × 10

Total Work = (12 + 8) × 10

Total Work = 200 units

Now calculate the time taken by 20 men to complete the same work:

Total work = 200 = (20m) × D

⇒ 200 = (20 × 2) × D

⇒ 200 = 40 × D

⇒ D = 200 ÷ 40

⇒ D = 5 days

**∴ The time taken by 20 men to complete the work is 5 days.**
